parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: Filters the application list by application name.

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: Filters the application list by cluster.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return in a paged query. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: LogicalRegionId
parameters.description: Filters the application list by microservices namespace.

parameters.name: LogicalRegionIdFilter
parameters.description: Filters applications by exact match of the microservices namespace.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page in a paged query.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: Filters the application list by resource group.
